records.Title: Implementing Schedule Policy/Career in the Excepted Service
records.Summary of Oppty: Formalizes creation of Schedule Policy/Career, including by amending civil service rules. Lists out Schedule P/C positions in each agency and subagency.

records.Title: Strengthening Customs Enforcement
records.Summary of Oppty: Creates new rules for importation.

records.Title: Promoting Advanced Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Security
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets general policy of promoting AI with minimal regulation. Directs military agencies to prioritize cybersecurity. Creates benchmarking process for AI tools.

records.Title: Realigning United States Core Childhood Vaccine Recommendations With Best Practices From Peer, Developed Countries
records.Summary of Oppty: Calls for increased alignment between US and European vaccine schedules and for the CDC to consider ways to provide maximum flexibility to parents and doctors through recommendations for timing and sequencing of the administration of routine immunizations.

records.Title: Removing Unnecessary and Counterproductive Restrictions on Access to Federal Lands
records.Summary of Oppty: Rescinds two 1970s Executive Orders that prohibited or minimized the use of off-road vehicles on public lands.

records.Title: Emergency Presidential Determination on Refugee Admissions for Fiscal Year 2026
records.Summary of Oppty: Trump's overall refugee ceiling of 7,500 is the lowest since at least 1980. In this PD, he increases the ceiling to 17,500 (the lowest ceiling previously was in 2020 at 18,000). The PD indicates that all "additional admissions shall be allocated among Afrikaners from South Africa."

records.Title: Integrating Financial Technology Innovation Into Regulatory Frameworks
records.Summary of Oppty: Generally sets policy of integrating fintech into financial regulations, but with the goal of reducing regulations for the industry overall

records.Title: Restoring Integrity to America's Financial System
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets policy of detering fraud and abuse in financial system. Seems to focus on payroll tax evasion - but with an immigraiton bent, like P2P payments to people who are undocumented, use of ITIN to get a credit card, etc.

records.Title: Promoting Efficiency, Accountability, and Performance in Federal Contracting
records.Summary of Oppty: Generally sets policy of a preference for fixed-cost contracts (as opposed to "cost reimbursement" contracts). Requires agency head to approve any non-fixed-cost contract above a specified dollar amount (varies by agency). Calls on agencies to renegotiate/modify its 10 largest non-fixed-price contracts. Requires semi-annual report to OMB on number of, value of, and written justifications for, any non-fixed-price contracts approved by agency heads.

records.Title: Promoting Retirement-Savings Access for American Workers by Establishing TrumpIRA.gov
records.Summary of Oppty: Creates "Trump IRAs," which are intended to provide a retirement savings option for workers who don't have access to an employer plan. Under recent legislation, savers are eligible for a "Federal Savers Match" of up to $1,000.

records.Title: Accelerating Medical Treatments for Serious Mental Illness
records.Summary of Oppty: Orders FDA and DEA to facilitate access to psychedelic drugs for the treatment of mental illness. Directs ARPA-H to allocate at least $50m to support psychedelic treatment programs.

records.Title: Day of Celebration in Honor of the Life of Henry Clay
records.Summary of Oppty: Renames the State Dept office in EEOB after Henry Clay, the Great Compromiser, who co-founded the American Colonization Society, which founded Liberia and then shipped freed slavest there.

records.Title: Urgent National Action To Save College Sports
records.Summary of Oppty: Outlines policies and recommends guidance for federal grantmaking on topics like eligbility limits, transfers, revenue-sharing, etc.

records.Title: Ensuring Citizenship Verification and Integrity in Federal Elections
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets general purpose and policy of verifying identity and eligibility in voting. Directs DHS and SSA "to compile and transmit to the chief election official of each State a list of individuals confirmed to be United States citizens who will be above the age of 18 at the time of an upcoming Federal election and who maintain a residence in the subject State... The State Citizenship List shall be derived from Federal citizenship and naturalization records, SSA records, SAVE data, and other relevant Federal databases." Directs USPS to issue a regulation on voting by mail. Tasks the AG with ensuring enforcement of the EO and relevant regulations.

records.Title: Addressing DEI Discrimination by Federal Contractors
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets general policy to "promote economy and efficiency in Federal contracting by preventing racial discrimination." Requires federal contractors to agree not to engage in DEI efforts on pain of losing federal contracts. Among other requirements, contractors must agree to "furnish all information and reports, including providing access to books, records, and accounts, as required by the contracting agency... for purposes of ascertaining compliance with this clause."

records.Title: Establishing the Task Force To Eliminate Fraud
records.Summary of Oppty: Generally sets policy of using "all available resources and authorities to fight fraud, close loopholes, enforce eligibility rules, and protect benefits for eligible Americans, while ensuring States administering Federal benefits programs do the same." Sets up a Task Force designed to develop improved eligibility verification and faud indicators, facilitate data sharing, and increase fraud enforcement. Calls on each agency to submit a report in 30 days, to adopt anti-fraud requirements in 60 days, and to submit an implementation plan within 90 days.

records.Title: Ensuring Truthful Advertising of Products Claiming To Be Made in America
records.Summary of Oppty: Generally, decries products that falsely claim to be made in America. Tasks FTC with enforcing false claims of American origins and suggests (but does not mandate) rulemaking from FTC and other agencies on labeling, deceptive trade practies, and other topics. Calls for review of acquisitions under Buy American Act.

records.Title: Promoting Access to Mortgage Credit
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets general policy of improving availability and affordability of mortgages. Directs significant de-regulation ostensibly to further that goal, along with increases in digital mortgages and a reduction in enforcement. Includes provision that would reduce HMDA reporting; HMDA data is used to identify discrimination in mortgage provision and to assess community housing needs.

records.Title: Removing Regulatory Barriers to Affordable Home Construction
records.Summary of Oppty: Generally, sets policy of de-regulating home construction. Calls on agencies to maximize exemptions to environmental protection, historic preservation, and other similar laws.

records.Title: Commitment to Countering Cartel Criminal Activity
records.Summary of Oppty: Claims that cartels are controlling terriories, commerce, political systems, etc. and commits to eradicating them alongside 17 countries that have suggested they will join the fight.

records.Title: Combating Cybercrime, Fraud, and Predatory Schemes Against American Citizens
records.Summary of Oppty: Generally, sets policy of increasing protections against and enforcement of laws criminalizing cybercrime and predatory schemes. Calls for a report in 60 days on strategies to combat cybercrime and an action plan in 120 for increased prevention and enforcement.

records.Title: Restoring American Seafood Competitiveness
records.Summary of Oppty: Announces 7 companies committing to Ratepayer Protection Pledge, under which AI companies guarantee that data centers' energy needs will not increase household electricity costs for American citizens.

records.Title: Strengthening United States National Defense With America's Beautiful Clean Coal Power Generation Fleet
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets a policy of procuring energy from coal power plants for military installations wherever possible.

records.Title: Protecting the National Security and Welfare of the United States and Its Citizens From Criminal Actors and Other Public Safety Threats
records.Summary of Oppty: Requires DOJ to share criminal history records information with DHS to the extent possible under law for immigration enforcement purposes, and where possible to share criminal history record information with foreign countries for the purpose of screening travelers and immigrants.

records.Title: Establishing an America First Arms Transfer Strategy
records.Summary of Oppty: Calls on the Sec of War to write and implement an America First Arms Transfer Strategy, intended to ensure that future arms sales prioritize American interests by using foreign purchases and capital to build American production and capacity.

records.Title: Unleashing American Commercial Fishing in the Atlantic
records.Summary of Oppty: Removes commercial fishing restrictions in place for the Northeast Canyons and Seamounts Marine National Monument.

records.Title: Addressing Addiction Through the Great American Recovery Initiative
records.Summary of Oppty: Launches the WH Great American Recovery Initiative, which is tasked with recommending steps to coordinate the Federal Government's response to the addiction crisis, including by better aligning relevant Federal programs, setting clear objectives, and providing data-driven updates to the public on progress towards meeting these objectives.

records.Title: Addressing State and Local Failures To Rebuild Los Angeles After Wildfire Disasters
records.Summary of Oppty: Generally sets policy of speeding up disaster response in CA. Preempts local permitting rules and calls for legislative action to improve FEMA.

records.Title: Stopping Wall Street From Competing With Main Street Homebuyers
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets general policy that large institutional investors shouldn't buy single-family homes that could be purchased by families, and calls on agencies with housing programs to prohibit facilitating acquisition by institutional investors.

records.Title: Designating the Board of Peace as a Public International Organization Entitled To Enjoy Certain Privileges, Exemptions, and Immunities
records.Summary of Oppty: Designates the Board of Peace as a public international organization in which the United States participates within the meaning of the International Organizations Immunities Act.

records.Title: Safeguarding Venezuelan Oil Revenue for the Good of the American and Venezuelan People
records.Summary of Oppty: Seems to say the US will hold Venezuelan oil revenues in trust for the Venezuelan people and that they cannot be attached by any judicial process - assumingly even by Venezuelan or international courts.

records.Title: Withdrawing the United States From International Organizations, Conventions, and Treaties That Are Contrary to the Interests of the United States
records.Summary of Oppty: Withdraws the US from 31 UN entities, from UN Oceans to the Convention on Climate Change to the Democracy Fund and the Peacebuilding Commission. Also withdraws the US from 35 other international conventions and treaties, including programs related to education, freedom online, counterterrorism, cyber expertise, and several on climate change and renewable energy.

records.Title: Prioritizing the Warfighter in Defense Contracting
records.Summary of Oppty: Calls on DOD to create a list of underperforming defense contractors and to prepare remediation plans with each. Requires a provision in new defense contracts that prohibits both stock buy-backs and payment of dividends during any period of underperformance or non-compliance with the terms of the contract.

records.Title: Increasing Medical Marijuana and Cannabidiol Research
records.Summary of Oppty: Calls for rescheduling marijuana to Schedule III, for additional research on medical marijuana, and for FDA guidance on dosage and per container limits and ratios of CBD to THC per container.

records.Title: Ensuring American Space Superiority
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets out the Admin's space priorities, which include returning to the moon, setting up a permanent lunar outpost, building space military defense technocoliges, and deploying nuclear reactors on the moon and in space.

records.Title: Restricting and Limiting the Entry of Foreign Nationals To Protect the Security of the United States
records.Summary of Oppty: Bars or dramatically restricts entry into the US of people from about 40 countries deemed to conduct insufficient vetting of visa holders.

records.Title: Designating Fentanyl as a Weapon of Mass Destruction
records.Summary of Oppty: Designates fentanyl and its core precursor chemicals as weapons of mass destruction (WMDs).

records.Title: Ensuring a National Policy Framework for Artificial Intelligence
records.Summary of Oppty: Asserts that state laws regulating AI interfere with national security interests. Calls on DOJ to assess and challenge state AI-related regulations and to withhold BEAD funding from states who fail to align with the Administration's strategy. Directs OSTP and WH staff to write AI legislation that would preempt any state law.

records.Title: Protecting American Investors From Foreign-Owned and Politically-Motivated Proxy Advisors
records.Summary of Oppty: Accuses shareholder proxy advisors of acting in a politically motivated way, including when they support DEI or ESG proposals. Calls on SEC Chair to regulate activities of proxy advisors and to investigate for unfair and deceptive practices. Calls on DOL to strengthen fiduciary standards for proxy advisors of pension funds.

records.Title: Addressing Security Risks From Price Fixing and Anti-Competitive Behavior in the Food Supply Chain
records.Summary of Oppty: Requires the AG and the Chair of the FTC to establish Food Supply Chain Security Task Forces to determine whether anti-competitive behavior exists in food supply chains and whether control of food-related industries by foreign entities is increasing the cost of food products in the United States or creating a national or economic security threat to Americans. Requires reports to Congress in 180 days.

records.Title: Designation of Certain Muslim Brotherhood Chapters as Foreign Terrorist Organizations
records.Summary of Oppty: Designates certain chapters of the Muslim Brotherhood as Foreign Terrorist Organizations and calls for a report on various chapters for the purpose of determining which ones to target.

records.Title: Launching the Genesis Mission
records.Summary of Oppty: According to the EO, the Genesis Mission will build an integrated AI platform to harness Federal scientific datasets to train scientific foundation models and create AI agents to test new hypotheses, automate research workflows, and accelerate scientific breakthroughs. The goal of the mission is to dramatically accelerate scientific discovery, strengthen national security, secure energy dominance, enhance workforce productivity, and multiply the return on taxpayer investment into research and development, thereby furthering America's technological dominance and global strategic leadership. The EO calls on the Secretary of Energy to lead the project, leveraging its supercomputers.

records.Title: Letter From the President to United States Steel Corporation Senior Vice President, General Counsel and Secretary Scot Duncan
records.Summary of Oppty: This letter memorializes the Golden Share agreement Nippon Steel entered into with the US, which means that they have a say-so over any attempt to sell the company or fundamentally reorganize what the company is trying to do.

records.Title: Fostering the Future for American Children and Families
records.Summary of Oppty: Generally sets the policy of improving child welfare system, including improving data collection and state child welfare information systems, increasing the use of "predictive analytics" tools to improve child and caregiver matching, launching a needs assessment for former foster youth, and improving transition services for children coming out of the foster system. Also directs HHS and WH entities to "address State and local policies and practices that inappropriately prohibit participation in federally-funded child-welfare programs by qualified individuals or organizations based upon their sincerely-held religious beliefs or moral convictions."

records.Title: Granting Pardons for Certain Offenses Related to the 2020 Presidential Election
records.Summary of Oppty: Grants blanket pardon to people who were charged with "conduct relating to their efforts to expose voting fraud and vulnerabilities in the 2020 Presidential Election."

records.Title: Ensuring Continued Accountability in Federal Hiring
records.Summary of Oppty: Requires each agency to establish a Strategic Hiring Committee that will approve the creation or filling of all vacancies within the agency and to produce an annual staffing plan and quarterly updates. Reaffirms requirement to comply with the Merit Hiring Plan.

records.Title: Presidential Determination on Refugee Admissions for Fiscal Year 2026
records.Summary of Oppty: Allows admission of up to 7,500 refugees for 2026, and sets priority for Afrikaners from South Africa. Note that in the previous 4 years, the number was 125,000 and priority was much more geographically diverse.

records.Title: Unlocking Cures for Pediatric Cancer With Artificial Intelligence
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets policy of increased research on pediatric cancer, especially by increasing use of AI. Calls for increased data sharing.

records.Title: Saving TikTok While Protecting National Security
records.Summary of Oppty: Deterimination that the divestiture agreement TikTok entered into is sufficient to protect americans from foreign influence such that using TikTok in the US is no longer prohibited.

records.Title: Countering Domestic Terrorism and Organized Political Violence
records.Summary of Oppty: Tasks the Joint Terrorism Task Force (JTTF) with investigating and prosecuting the recruitment or radicalizing of people for the purposes of "political violence, terrorism, or conspiracy against rights; or the violent deprivation of any citizens' rights." Also calls on the JTTF to investigate institutional and individual funders. Requires AG to issue guidance on priorities that will include "behaviors, fact patterns, recurrent motivations, or other indicia..." common to the organizations it deems to be involved in this kind of activity. Ostensibly responsive to Charlie Kirk assassination and OSF funding of Palestinian groups.

records.Title: Designating Antifa as a Domestic Terrorist Organization
records.Summary of Oppty: Designates antifa as a domestic terrorist organization. Uses unclear and potentially sweeping language, saying the group uses "illegal means to organize and execute a campaign of violence and terrorism nationwide to accomplish these goals. This campaign involves coordinated efforts to obstruct enforcement of Federal laws through armed standoffs with law enforcement, organized riots, violent assaults on Immigration and Customs Enforcement and other law enforcement officers, and routine doxing of and other threats against political figures and activists."

records.Title: The Gold Card
records.Summary of Oppty: Establishes a program within DOC under which immigrants can pay $1m for a visa. (Or companies can buy a visa for a sponsee for $2m.)

records.Title: Restriction on Entry of Certain Nonimmigrant Workers
records.Summary of Oppty: Citing layoffs and a tight labor market in the IT field, restricts use of H(1)(b) visas for these kinds of specialty occupations for the next year.

records.Title: Restoring the United States Department of War
records.Summary of Oppty: Renames the Department of Defense the Department of War.

records.Title: Strengthening Efforts To Protect U.S. Nationals From Wrongful Detention Abroad
records.Summary of Oppty: Creates a mechanism for designating a foreign country that directly engages in or provides support for the wrongful detention of a U.S. national as a State Sponsor of Wrongful Detention and directs the Sec of State to review existing authorities that can be leveraged against designated countries.

records.Title: Use of Appropriated Funds for Illegal Lobbying and Partisan Political Activity by Federal Grantees
records.Summary of Oppty: According to the PM, federal funding reviews have revealed that taxpayer funds are being spent on "grants with highly political overtones." Directs AG to investigate whether Federal grant funds are being used to illegally support lobbying activities and to take appropriate enforcement action. Requires the AG to provide a progress report within 180 days.

records.Title: Further Exclusions From the Federal Labor- Management Relations Program
records.Summary of Oppty: Excludes a number of agencies and subagencies from union protections by determining they have "a primary function intelligence, counterintelligence, investigative, or national security work." Components include ITA, PTO, NASA, and the National Weather Service.

records.Title: Making Federal Architecture Beautiful Again
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets policy that classical architecture is the preferred style for federal buildings in DC and directs GSA to use that style for any renovation, reduction, or expansion where feasible.

records.Title: Prosecuting Burning of the American Flag
records.Summary of Oppty: Directs DOJ to prioritize prosecutions of people who desecrate the American flag.

records.Title: Additional Measures To Address the Crime Emergency in the District of Columbia
records.Summary of Oppty: Directs hiring of additional police and prosecutors for DC, increased use of federal law enforcement in DC, increased enforcement of public housing prohibitions on tenant activiites, and additional inspections and audits of the Metro.

records.Title: Measures To End Cashless Bail and Enforce the Law in the District of Columbia
records.Summary of Oppty: Declares that DC is experiencing a "crime emergency," and calls for an end to DC's cashless bail policy. Directs the AG to review DC's policy to see if cashless bail remains a practice, and if he determines it remains a practice, to use any authorities available to press DC to change course.

records.Title: Taking Steps To End Cashless Bail To Protect Americans
records.Summary of Oppty: Directs AG to create a list of jurisdictions that have eliminated cash bail and for all federal agencies to review funds provided to those jurisdictions to see if they can be suspended or terminated.

records.Title: Improving Our Nation Through Better Design
records.Summary of Oppty: Establishes a National Design Studio within the EOP tasked with comprehensively improving the visual presentation and usability of Federal services provided to the public in both digital and physical spaces. Requires agencies to "produce initial results" by July 4, 2026.

records.Title: Ensuring American Pharmaceutical Supply Chain Resilience by Filling the Strategic Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients Reserve
records.Summary of Oppty: Directs HHS to identify the 26 drugs that are especially critical to the health and security interests of the Nation and to stockpile those ingredients to the extent possible.

records.Title: Enabling Competition in the Commercial Space Industry
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets policy of enabling a competitive space launch market and directs DOT and DOC to streamline commercial license and permit approvals and limiting environmental review.

records.Title: Declaring a Crime Emergency in the District of Columbia
records.Summary of Oppty: Declares a state of emergency in DC, citing (disputed) high crime rates and federalizes the Metro PD.

records.Title: Establishing a Trump Route for International Peace and Prosperity Working Group
records.Summary of Oppty: The Armenia-Azerbaijan peace treaty included a provision allowing the US gov't to maintain a road through the region named after Trump. This PM establishes a working group to effectuate that requirement.

records.Title: Improving Oversight of Federal Grantmaking
records.Summary of Oppty: Requires each agency to designate a senior appointee to review all discretionary grantmaking by the agency. Requires all discretionary funding to support the President's policy priorities and prohibits grants that "fund, promote, encourage, subsidize, or facilitate... racial preferences...including activities where race or intentional proxies for race will be used as a selection criterion for employment or program participation, denial... of the sex binary... or the notion that sex is a chosen or mutable characteristic, illegal immigration, or any other initiatives that compromise public safety or promote anti-American values." Requires agencies to prioritize institutions with low overheads and give to a broad range of recipients rather than "repeat players." Each agency is required to report on compliance and grant cancellation flexibilities within 30 days.

records.Title: Guaranteeing Fair Banking for All Americans
records.Summary of Oppty: Prohibits banking regulators from considering "reputational risk" in their assessments of banks' risk profiles. Ostensibly aimed at prohibiting banks from "debanking" conservatives, industry response indicates that this will reduce reporting burden but is not a consisten problem. Notably, the entities referenced in the EO (e.g., Cabela's) have a history of deceptive banking practices.

records.Title: Democractizing Access to Alternative Assets for 401(k) Investors
records.Summary of Oppty: Directs DOL to assess guidance that constrains the types of investments made with retirement account funds so that riskier investements (e.g., digital assets, real estate, private market investments) are permitted.

records.Title: Establishing the White House Task Force on the 2028 Summer Olympics
records.Summary of Oppty: Initiates a task force to conduct activities to prepare for the 2028 Summer Olympics chaired by the president and VP. Reports due Oct. 1, 2025.

records.Title: President's Council on Sports, Fitness, and Nutrition, and the Reestablishment of the Presidential Fitness Test
records.Summary of Oppty: Reestablishes the Presidential Fitness Test and a related council. Notably, frames many of the goals of this council and program focus on "military readiness."

records.Title: Ending Crime and Disorder on America's Streets
records.Summary of Oppty: Generally calls people experiencing homelessness criminals and calls for using the civil commitment system to "shift" them into "long-term institutional settings." Requires AG and HHS to provide guidance to states on how to maximize the use of civil commitment and to provide grants to states to increase the criminalization of homelessness. Ends support for housing first policies and programs and directs the AG to prosecute organizations conducting harm reduction programs.

records.Title: Saving College Sports
records.Summary of Oppty: Calls for universities to provide more scholarships in "non-revenue and women's" sports programs, and calls on HHS and ED to develop an implementation plan.

records.Title: Accelerating Federal Permitting of Data Center Infrastructure
records.Summary of Oppty: Directs OSTP and DOC to launch a program to support data center development, waives a number of climate-related permitting requirements, and requires DOI and DOE to idenify federal lands that can be used for data centers.

records.Title: Promoting the Export of the American AI Technology Stack
records.Summary of Oppty: Generally, sets policy of extending American leadership in AI and decreasing international dependence on AI technologies developed by "our adversaries" by supporting the global deployment of United States-origin AI technologies. Requires DOC and OSTP to establish an American AI Exports Program and to issue an RFP in 90 days for program participation.

records.Title: Continuation of the National Emergency With Respect to Significant Transnational Criminal Organizations
records.Summary of Oppty: Continues the effective date of the national ermergency declared in EO 13581.

records.Title: Preventing Woke AI in the Federal Government
records.Summary of Oppty: Requires federal agencies to only use AI/LLMs that are "truth-seeking" and that "do not manipulate responses in favor of ideological dogmas such as DEI." Requires OMB to produce implementation guidance within 120 days.

records.Title: Creating Schedule G in the Excepted Service
records.Summary of Oppty: Creates a new political appointee class of positions in the federal government for appointing people to positions of a policy-making or policy-advocating character normally subject to change as a result of a Presidential transition.

records.Title: Ending Market Distorting Subsidies for Unreliable, Foreign-Controlled Energy Sources
records.Summary of Oppty: Generally, calls for an end to all subsidies and tax credits for green energy. Requires Treasury and Interior to review all regulations and policies for any preferential treatment of wind and solar energy production.

records.Title: Establishing the President's Make America Beautiful Again Commission
records.Summary of Oppty: Ostensibly, sets policy of conserving national parks and recreation areas. Creates internal commission with members from agencies, COS, NEC, and CEQ. Directs commission to provide recommendations on conservation, focusing on expanding hunting and fishing, voluntary conservation efforts, driving economic growth, and reducing regulation.

records.Title: Making America Beautiful Again by Improving Our National Parks
records.Summary of Oppty: Directs the Secretary of Interior to create a plan to increase fees at national parks and to remove recreation restrictions at parks. Revokes national parks PM, which called on national parks to increase diversity and inclusion.

records.Title: Implementing the General Terms of the United States of America-United Kingdom Economic Prosperity Deal
records.Summary of Oppty: This EO lays out the terms of the US-UK trade/tariff agreement.

records.Title: Further Extending the TikTok Enforcement Delay
records.Summary of Oppty: Delays implementation of the TikTok ban by an additional 75 days.

records.Title: 250th Anniversary of the Founding of the United States Army
records.Summary of Oppty: Celebrates the 250th anniversary of the army, including by celebrating purging DEI and transgender people from the military.

records.Title: Empowering Commonsense Wildfire Prevention and Response
records.Summary of Oppty: Requires USDA, DOI, and other government entities to take a series of actions that would streamline federal wildfire response capabilities, including consolidating programs, expanding state collaborations, and eliminating regulations that delay the provision of federal support. The EO also requires USDA and DHS to produce a technology roadmap to increase firefighting capabilities and to declassify certain satellite imagery that would improve prediction and evaluation models.

records.Title: Restricting the Entry of Foreign Nationals To Protect the United States From Foreign Terrorists and Other National Security and Public Safety Threats
records.Summary of Oppty: Citing national security concerns, this proclamation fully restricts entry into the US of people from 12 countries and partially restricts entry for people from an additional 7 countries. The proclamation includes specific reasons for limitations from each country, mostly for one of the following: (1) high visa overstay rates, (2) insufficient central document authority in the country, (3) refusal to accept the country's nationals who have been deported from the US, or (4) state sponsorship of terrorism.

records.Title: Enhancing National Security by Addressing Risks at Harvard University
records.Summary of Oppty: Because Harvard has refused to turn over records on international students to DHS, this proclamation prohibits granting student visas to international students intending to study at Harvard and directs State to review visas of current international Harvard students for potential revocation.

records.Title: Unleashing American Drone Dominance
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets general policy of increasing US drone production. Requires DOT to issue regulations on drones and to use AI to expedite review of drone waiver applications; also directs DOT not to make drone flights "subject to onerous requirements…" Calls for new drone pilot program.

records.Title: Restoring American Airspace Sovereignty
records.Summary of Oppty: Laments unlawful use of drones by drug cartels and to disrupt mass gatherings and calls on NSC to initiate a Task Force to address US airspace sovereignty. Requires new drone regulations and enhanced tracking of drone flights.

records.Title: Leading the World in Supersonic Flight
records.Summary of Oppty: Repeals FAA prohibition on overland supersonic flight and calls for FAA to issue new regulations on supersonic flight noise; calls for additional R+D on supersonic flight.

records.Title: Sustaining Select Efforts To Strengthen the Nation's Cybersecurity and Amending Executive Order 13694 and Executive Order 14144
records.Summary of Oppty: Amends late Biden-era EO on cybersecurity to expand scope, put new deadlines in place, and change the focus of federal cybersecurity efforts.

records.Title: 101st Anniversary of the United States Border Patrol
records.Summary of Oppty: Generally celebrates 101st anniversary of CBP. Includes summary statistics of border enforcement activities during first 100 days.

records.Title: National Physical Fitness and Sports Month
records.Summary of Oppty: Declared May National Fitness and Sports Month and cheers Admin actions to "keep biological men out of women's sports."

records.Title: Restoring Gold Standard Science
records.Summary of Oppty: Avers that federal agencies are have been using bad science to make policy and commits to "restoring" credible, reliable, and impartial scientific evidence. Requires OSTP to issue guidance on Gold Standard Science within 30 days. Requires each agency to update its policies (including scientific integrity policies) to reflect OSTP guidance and to submit a progress report on implemetnation with 60 days of guidance. Calls on agencies to rescind scientific integrity policies issued during Biden Admin and to review any actions taken pursuant to the Scientific integrity EO.

records.Title: Reinvigorating the Nuclear Industrial Base
records.Summary of Oppty: Directs DOE to increase production of nuclear fuel, including the recycling of spent nuclear fuel.

records.Title: Deploying Advanced Nuclear Reactor Technologies for National Security
records.Summary of Oppty: Requires deployment of advanced nuclear energy plants at various USG facilities, including a military base and DOE facilities.

records.Title: Reforming Nuclear Reactor Testing at the Department of Energy
records.Summary of Oppty: Requires increased testing of nuclear energy, including through a pilot program outside of the National Labs.

records.Title: Ordering the Reform of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets policy of reestablishing US as global leader in production of nuclear energy and facilitating nuclear power plant production 4x by 2050. Requires a complete overhaul of NRC policies and practices within 9-18 months.

records.Title: Modifying Reciprocal Tariff Rates To Reflect Discussions With the People's Republic of China
records.Summary of Oppty: Reduces some of the tariffs on imports from PRC to 10% (though others remain higher).

records.Title: Delivering Most-Favored-Nation Prescription Drug Pricing to American Patients
records.Summary of Oppty: Generally sets policy of requiring pharmaceutical companies to offer drugs for the same price in the US as they do in poorer countries abroad. Requires DOC to communicate price targets to pharmaceutical companies in 30 days and if companies don't make progress toward these targets, to initiate a regulation to achieve it. Also asks DOC to consider importing lower cost prescription drugs.

records.Title: Keeping Promises to Veterans and Establishing a National Center for Warrior Independence
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets policy of supporting homeless veterans. Directs VA to designate a section of the West LA VA Campus as the National Center for Warrior Independence which will serve homeless vets from around the country, including by supporting vets from elsewhere in getting to the center. Requires a progress report in 120 days. Also directs VA to create a plan in 60 days on reducing wait times for VHA appointments, to explore opening a VA center in New Hampshire, and to explore whether vets should be able to receive care at military facilities (and vice versa).

records.Title: Increasing Efficiency at the Office of the Federal Register
records.Summary of Oppty: Directs OFR to reduce average publication times for various types of documents and to review fees required for publication.

records.Title: Fighting Overcriminalization in Federal Regulations
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets a general policy of strongly discouraging criminal enforcement of criminal regulatory offenses and of "disfavoring" strict liability offenses. Requires AG to prepare a report in one year of all regulations that include criminal liability along with the range of applicable penalties and mens rea requirement for each and to update that report yearly. Clarifies that the EO does not impact immigration enforcement.

records.Title: Establishing Project Homecoming
records.Summary of Oppty: Directs DHS to establish a "concierge service" under which it will pay for the travel costs and an "exit bonus" for undocumented people who voluntarily self-deport. It also directs them to conduct a campaign explaining the consequences of not self-deporting and to increase the number of immigration officers by 20,000 within 60 days to "conduct an intensive campaign to remove illegal aliens who have failed to depart voluntarily."

records.Title: Regulatory Relief To Promote Domestic Production of Critical Medicines
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets general policy of deregulating pharmaceutical manufacturing in the US. Directs FDA to review pharmaceutical regulations and eliminate any that are unnecessary and to take several other actions to facilitate increased production. Requires increased inspection of and fees on foreign manufacturing. Requires EPA to reduce regulation of the industry and to speed NEPA review.

records.Title: Improving the Safety and Security of Biological Research
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets policy of stopping federal funded gain-of-function research through OSTP and HHS. Requires OSTP to limit and track non-federally funding gain-of-function research. Requires HHS to include provisions in all new life-sciences research that grantees not collaborate with foreign entities on gain-of-function research and that if they violate that provision they'll be subject to a 5-year ban on federal funding.

records.Title: Establishment of the Religious Liberty Commission
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets policy that the "Federal Government will promote citizens' pride in our foundational history, identify emerging threats to religious liberty, uphold Federal laws that protect all citizens' full participation in a pluralistic democracy, and protect the free exercise of religion." Sets up Religious Liberty Commission and directs it to produce a report on religious liberty and to advise the WH on steps to secure religious liberty through executive or legilsative action. Commission will be housed at DOJ.

records.Title: Ending Taxpayer Subsidization of Biased Media
records.Summary of Oppty: Directs Corporation for Public Broadcasting to cease funding for NPR and PBS, including indirectly through public radio and TV station payments to NPR and PBS. Directs HHS to review whether PBS and NBC are complying with non-discrimination law.

records.Title: Addressing Certain Tariffs on Imported Articles
records.Summary of Oppty: Seems to clarify that tariffs imposed through various Executive Orders and other Presidential actions do not "stack" - or are not to be considered cumulative.

records.Title: Amendments to Adjusting Imports of Automobiles and Automobile Parts Into the United States
records.Summary of Oppty: Reduces some of the tariffs on cars and car parts.

records.Title: Strengthening and Unleashing America's Law Enforcement To Pursue Criminals and Protect Innocent Citizens
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets policy of support for LEOs, including those who are sued for "equity" reasons (assumingly, policy shootings and use of force). Directs AG to provide legal resources and indemnification to all LEOs, including "the use of private-sector pro bono assistance for such law enforcement officers." This intimates that law firms targeted under EOs will defend police. Requires AG to review consent decrees to remove any provisions that "unduly impede... law enforcement." Calls for increased provision of military weapons and assets to state and local law enforcement. Suggest AG should pursue legal actions against officials in jurisdictions that have LEO DEI programs.

records.Title: Protecting American Communities From Criminal Aliens
records.Summary of Oppty: Claims sanctuary cities violate federal law. Requires AG to produce a list of sanctuary cities and for OMB to suspend or terminate federal funding to those cities and for DOJ to prosecute them as appropriate.

records.Title: Enforcing Commonsense Rules of the Road for America's Truck Drivers
records.Summary of Oppty: Makes English proficiency a requirement for having a commercial drivers license. Requires DOT to rescind language access memo and issue new guidance in 60 days.

records.Title: Unleashing America's Offshore Critical Minerals and Resources
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets policy of rapidly developing offshore mining of critical minerals through deregulation, investment, and supply chain management. Calls on impacted agencies to expedite permitting, grants, and loans for these projects.

records.Title: Strengthening Probatinary Periods in the Federal Service
records.Summary of Oppty: Issues new civil service rule requiring agencies to make an affirmative decision regarding retention for employees after their probabionary period. Requires new probationary periods following reassignment or promotion. Rescinds prior probation rule and directs OPM to issue a new subpart H rule in 30 days. Requires all agencies to ID staff currently on probation and to ID someone who will adjudicate continued employment for probationary employees at their one-year mark.

records.Title: Reinstating Commonsense School Discipline Policies
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets policy of no longer considering racial disparities and inequities in school discipline. Requires ED and DOJ guidance in 30 days "regarding school discipline and their obligations not to engage in racial discrimination under Title VI in all contexts, including school discipline." Requires new DOD school discipline code in 90 days and a report from ED, AG, HHS, and DHS in 120 days on "the status of discriminatory-equity-ideology-based school discipline and behavior modification techniques in American public education.."

records.Title: White House Initiative To Promote Excellence and Innovation at Historically Black Colleges and Universities
records.Summary of Oppty: Generally sets a policy of supporting HBCUs, but first direction for WHI on HBCUs is to increase private sector role. Revokes EPA HBCU advisory council.

records.Title: Preparing Americans for High-Paying Skilled Trade Jobs of the Future
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets policy of strengthening Apprenticeships programs. Requires report in 90 days on strategies to help workers. Requires plan in 120 days on ways to surpass 1 million new active apprentices. Requires increased transparency on performance outcomes of workforce development programs.

records.Title: Reforming Accreditation to Strengthen Higher Education
records.Summary of Oppty: Directs ED to deny, monitor, suspend, or terminate accreditation recognition for accreditors that mandate DEI programs. Includes particular focus on law and medical schools. Calls for increasing the number of accreditors.

records.Title: Transparency Regarding Foreign Influence at American Universities
records.Summary of Oppty: Directs ED and AG to require disclosure by higher ed institutions of any foreign funding.

records.Title: Restoring Equality of Opportunity and Meritocracy
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets policy of eliminating disparate impact liability wherever possible. Revokes DOJ disparate impact regulations. Directs all agencies to deprioritize disparate impact investigations and to repeal any disparate impact regulations. Requires all agencies to review any proceedings currently under way and any consent decrees that rely on disparate impact theory. Directs AG to review state laws for preemption authority.

records.Title: Advancing Artificial Intelligence Education for American Youth
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets policy of promoting AI literacy and proficiency. Sets up Task Force on AI Education and directs it to initiate a Presidential AI Challenge in 90 days and enter into public private partnerships to produce AI education materials. Requires programs at ED, NSF, USDA, and DOL to prioritize AI research, education, and apprenticeships.

records.Title: Restoring American Seafood Competitiveness
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets general policy of promoting seafood production including by reducing regulations and protecting fisheries from "unfair foreign trade practices." Requires DOC and USTR to produce a Seafood Trade Strategy in 60 days. Requires DOC to review national parks and monuments to recommend whether any should be opened to commercial fishing within 180 days.

records.Title: Unleashing American Commercial Fishing in the Pacific
records.Summary of Oppty: Opens the Pacific Remote Islands Marine National Monument to commercial fishing. Requires DOC to amend or repeal all regulations that restrict commercial fishing in the PRIMNM.

records.Title: Preventing Illegal Aliens from Obtaining Social Security Act Benefits
records.Summary of Oppty: Directs DOL, HHS, SSA, and DHS to take all actions necessary to ensure that undocumented people don't receive SSA funds. Requires an expansion of SSA's fraud prosecutor program and requires HHS to share death records with SSA. Requires review of all recipients over age 100 and directs SSA to review whether to to pursue civil penalties against recipients deemed fraudulent.

records.Title: Ensuring National Security and Economic Resilience Through Section 232 Actions on Processed Critical Minerals and Derivative Products
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets policy of strengthening the supply chain for critical minerals, including by diversifying sources. Requires DOC to conduct a section 232 investigation on critical minerals imports and to produce a draft report in 90 days and a final report in 180 days.

records.Title: Restoring Common Sense to Federal Procurement
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets general policy of creating a more agile federal procurement process. Requires FAR council to review acquisition regulations and guidance and rescind anything that is not necessary within 180 days. Encourages amending all existing FAR regulations so that they sunset 4 years after their effective date.

records.Title: Restoring Common Sense to Federal Office Space Management
records.Summary of Oppty: Revokes two earlier EO's on federal office space siting.

records.Title: Ensuring Commercial, Cost-Effective Solutions in Federal Contracts
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets general policy of procuring products and services through commercial channels. Requires each agency to conduct a review in 60 days of all non-commercial contracts for consolidation and to include a justification for why a unique/custom/non-commercial product is necessary. Requires a progress report to OMB in 120 days. Increases OMB oversight of non-commercial acquisitions.

records.Title: Lowering Drug Prices by Once Again Putting Americans First
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets general policy of facilitating lower cost prescription drugs. Requires new Medicare Drug Price Negotiation Program guidance in 60 days and recommendations from DPC on lowering Part D premiums in 180 days. Requires HHS to issue regulations on MDPNP within 1 year. Requires a survey on hospital drug acquisition costs within 180 days and to make PHSA grants contingent on increasing access to insulin and epinephrine. Requires a number of other actions to increase drug competitiveness.

records.Title: Addressing Risks From Susman Godfrey
records.Summary of Oppty: Targets Susman Godfrey for having a DEI program and litigating election cases. Directs revocation of security clearnances for SG staff, terminating any existing contracts with SG and prohibiting future contracts with SG, and prohibiting hiring of any former SG attorneys without a waiver.

records.Title: Maintaining Acceptable Water Pressure in Showerheads
records.Summary of Oppty: Rescinds two regulations on showerheads.

records.Title: Modifying Reciprocal Tariff Rates To Reflect Trading Partner Retaliation and Alignment
records.Summary of Oppty: Withdraws or pauses several of the tariffs imposed against most countries and modifies several others.

records.Title: Restoring America's Maritime Dominance
records.Summary of Oppty: Generally sets policy of restoring maritime industries and workforce. Directs NSA to produce a Maritime Action Plan within 210 days. Requires DOD to provide inputs to NSA for the MAP within 180 days. Directs USTR to continue its investigation of Chinese maritime dominance and to consider tariffs. Directs a number of other actions to incentivize shipbuilding.

records.Title: Reforming Foreign Defense Sales To Improve Speed and Accountability
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets policy of facilitating foreign arms sales, making them more transparent and efficient. Requires State and DOD to create lists of priority partners and priority items for sale within 60 days and to update those lists annually.

records.Title: Zero-Based Regulatory Budgeting To Unleash American Energy
records.Summary of Oppty: Generally calls for rescinding outdated regulations that regulate the energy sector. Directs EPA, DOE, FERC, and NRC (including many specific subagencies) to issue Sunset Rules by 9/30 that insert one year sunset dates into regulations implementing about two dozen climate, science, and energy laws. Also requires those agencies to insert five-year sunset dates into all new regulations.

records.Title: Modernizing Defense Acquisitions and Spurring Innovation in the Defense Industrial Base
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets general policy of accelerating defense procurement. Requires DOD to produce a plan in 60 days to reform the DOD acquisition system. Requires DOD to review acquisition regulations and rescind outdated/unnecessary regulations a propose new ones. Requires DOD to submit a plan in 120 days on right-sizing the DOD acquisitions workforce and to submit a review of all acquisition programs within 90 days.

records.Title: Reducing Anti-Competitive Regulatory Barriers
records.Summary of Oppty: Requires all agencies to conduct a review of regulations that facilitate the creation of monopolies, that create barriers to entry for new market participants, or that otherwise limit competition. Agencies must provide a report of all identified regulations to FTC and the AG within 70 days. Requires FTC to issue an RFI on regulatory barriers in 10 days.

records.Title: Regulatory Relief for Certain Stationary Sources To Promote American Energy
records.Summary of Oppty: Exempts certain coal plants from emissions standards regulations issued in 2024, saying that the technology doesn't exist for the plants to comply. Note that the original compliance date was in 2027, new compliance date is in 2029.

records.Title: Strengthening the Reliability and Security of the US Electric Grid
records.Summary of Oppty: Generally sets a policy of producing sufficient energy for national needs and directs DOE to create a uniform methodology for estimating energy needs and required reserve margins within 30 days.

records.Title: Reinvigorating America's Beautiful Clean Coal Industry and Amending Executive Order 14241
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets policy of increasing domestic coal production. Requires DOI, USDA, and DOE to identify all coal resources on federal lands and proposals to mine them in 60 days. Ends Jewell Moratorium on coal mining on federal lands. Requires EPA, DOT, DOI, DOE, DOL, and Treasury to identify any regulations or guidance that are intended to transition the US away from coal production within 30 days and to rescind within 60 days. Encourages agencies to make grants and loans to support coal production. Requires an assessment of where coal could be used to support AI data centers and requires increased investment in coal technology reserach.

records.Title: Protecting American Energy from State Overreach
records.Summary of Oppty: Asserts that state climate change and energy laws are irreconcilable with federal policy. Directs AG to identify state climate laws and to take legal action against them, especially those the AG deems unconstitutional. Requires a progress report in 60 days.

records.Title: Amendment to Reciprocal Tariffs and Updated Duties as Applied to Low-Value Imports From the People's Republic of China
records.Summary of Oppty: Further amends tariffs on Chinese imports, generally by dramatically increasing tariff rate and marginally increasing de minimis exception.

records.Title: Extending the TikTok Enforcement Delay
records.Summary of Oppty: Extends TikTok enforcement delay through 6/19/25 and directs the AG to issue written guidance to providers that no enforcement action will be taken.

records.Title: National Sexual Assault Awareness and Prevention Month
records.Summary of Oppty: Proclamation language focuses on sexual violence committed by undocumented immigrants.

records.Title: National Child Abuse Prevention Month
records.Summary of Oppty: Proclamation language focuses on youth access to gender affirming care.

records.Title: Regulating Imports With a Reciprocal Tariff To Rectify Trade Practices That Contribute to Large and Persistent Annual United States Goods Trade Deficits
records.Summary of Oppty: Declares national emergency based on US trade deficit, creates a general policy of imposing a tariff on all imports of 10% and sets "reciprocal" tariffs for dozens of countries ranging from 11%-50%. Requires USTR, State, Treasury, DOC, DHS, NEC, NSA, etc. to submit regular reports on implementation.

records.Title: Further Amendment to Duties Addressing the Synthetic Opioid Supply Chain in the People's Republic of China as Applied to Low-Value Imports
records.Summary of Oppty: Additional edits to the de minimis exception to tariffs on Chinese goods.

records.Title: Establishing the US Investment Accelerator
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets policy of attracting domestic and foreign investment in US. Directs DOC to launch an Investment Accelerator in 30 days disigned to help companies navigate federal regulatory hurdles to investments of $1b or more. The IA will replace the CHIPS program office.

records.Title: Combating Unfair Practices in the Live Entertainment Market
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets policy of combatting unfair ticket prices and directs AG and FTC to strengthen enforcement of Better Online Ticket Sales Act. Directs FTC to consider regulations on ticket price transparency and to prevent deceptive conduct in secondary market. Requires implementation report from FTC, Treasury and AG in 180 days.

records.Title: Making DC Safe and Beautiful
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets policy of increasing law enforcement in DC. Establishes DC Safe and Beautiful Task Force, chaired by NSA, that is tasked with maximizing immigration enforcement, providing assistance to MPD, increasing pretrial detention, ending MTA fare evasion, and increasing law enforcement in parks. Directs Interior to prepare a DC beautification plan and to order the removal of all homeless encampments on federal land.

records.Title: Exclusions from Federal Labor-Management Relations Programs
records.Summary of Oppty: Exempts large portions of many federal agencies from federal labor-management relations programs (aka unions) by declaring them to have a primary function of intelligence, investigation, or national security. Includes traditional nat sec entities (E.g., State, Defense, DHS) as well as many entities for which the definition is difficult to understand - like the FDA, ORR, BLM, Food Safety and Inspection Service, DOT, EPA, USAID, NSF, GSA. Also excludes whole function of OCIO in every agency. Creates exception for all law enforcement unions. Directs agencies to dissolve CBAs and terminate grievance proceedings. Requires a report from each agency head in 30 days.

records.Title: Restoring Truth and Sanity to American History
records.Summary of Oppty: Describes the efforts at national parks and museums to uplift communities of color and LGBTQ people as divisive and negative. Directs VP to remove race, gender, and LGBTQ references from Smithsonian and national zoo, including by prohibiting funding for these topics and prohibiting Women's History Museum from including transgender women. Directs DOI to restore any removed monuments.

records.Title: Addressing Risks from Willmer Hale
records.Summary of Oppty: Targets Willmer Hale for hiring Robert Mueller and Aaron Zebley. Directs revocation of security clearnances for JB staff, terminating any existing contracts with WH and prohibiting future contracts with WH, and prohibiting hiring of any former WH attorneys without a waiver.

records.Title: Adjusting Imports of Automobiles and Automobile Parts Into the US
records.Summary of Oppty: Citing national security concerns, sets 25% tariff on imports of cars and car parts.

records.Title: Addressing Risks from Jenner & Block
records.Summary of Oppty: Targets Jenner Block for its work on transgender and immigration cases, as well as for hiring Andrew Weissmann. Directs revocation of security clearnances for JB staff, terminating any existing contracts with JB and prohibiting future contracts with JB, and prohibiting hiring of any former JB attorneys without a waiver.

records.Title: Protecting America's Bank Account Against Fraud, Waste, and Abuse
records.Summary of Oppty: Descibes how the General Fund works and asserts that Treasury needs additional information from client agencies to protect against waste, fraud, and abuse. Directs Treasury to issue additional guidance to agencies on pre-certification verification processes and gives Treasury sweeping access to payment data. Directs all agencies to modify SORNs in 90 days to allow for "routine use" by Treasury. Includes a number of recommendations for pre-certification verification guidance. Requires OMB to issue guidance in 180 days mandating that all agencies consolidate their payment systems. Requires Treasury to assess in 30 days whether it should continue delegating disbursement authority to other agencies. Requires compliance report from all agencies in 90 days and a report from Treasury to NEC on implementation in 180 days.

records.Title: Modernizing Payments To and From America's Bank Account
records.Summary of Oppty: Generally, sets a policy of minimizing non-electronic payments to and from the US government as a way to minimize waste, fraud, and abuse. Phases out paper checks as much as possible starting Sept. 25, 2025, including for fees, fines, loans, and taxes. Creates some exceptions, including for people who are unbanked and for emergency payments. Requires compliance plan from all agencies in 90 days and progress report from Treasury in 180 days.

records.Title: Preserving and Protecting the Integrity of American Elections
records.Summary of Oppty: Describes a set of challenges to free and fair elections, including use of mail-in voting, lack of ID checks, and allowing registration of non-citizens. Requires Election Assistance Commission (EAC) to make changes to National Mail Voter Registration Form including requiring proof of citizenship using an ID document. Requires DHS to allow SLTT officials to verify citizenship or immigration status and to review SLTT voter registration lists. Requires DHS to provide a list to DOJ of any non-citizen who has registered to vote. Requires SSA to make SS verification service, Death Master File, and other databases available to state and local election officials, and directs AG to ensure compliance with voter registration laws. Directs EAC to withhold funding from states that refuse to implement voter ID requirements and to review voting systems within 180 days. Directs AG to prosecute people who have committed election fraud or who have provided false info on registration forms. Directs AG and DHS to ensure non-citizens are not involved with voting, including volunteering. Prohibits counting votes received after election day. Prohibits foreign nationals from contributing to US elections.

records.Title: Imposing Tariffs on Countries Importing Venezuelan Oil
records.Summary of Oppty: Reiterates designation of Tren de Aragua as a terrorist organization and reaffirms existing sanctions against Venezuela. Imposes 25% tariff on goods from any country that imports Venezuelan oil directly or indirectly. Requires DOC to investigate what countries import oil from Venezuela and directs State and DOC to submit periodic reports to POTUS on implementation every 180 days.

records.Title: Addressing Remedial Action by Paul Weiss
records.Summary of Oppty: Revokes Paul Weiss EO from 3/14 in return for PW agreeing to several terms, including ending their DEI work, taking on more pro bono clients that reflect Trump's priorities, and denouncing former partner Mark Pomerantz.

records.Title: Strengthening the Suitability and Fitness of the Federal Workforce
records.Summary of Oppty: Directs OPM to issue regulations giving OPM authority to make final suitability determinations regarding employee post-appointment conduct. OPM will have the final say on terminations and can override agency head determinations. Note that this PM does not become effective until OPM issues its regulations.

records.Title: Stopping Waste, Fraud, and Abuse by Eliminating Information Silos
records.Summary of Oppty: Generally sets policy of improving data sharing among federal agencies, with DOGE, and from states. Requires agencies to provide full access to data to POTUS designees (e.g., DOGE staff). Requires each agency to produce a report to OMB in 30 days on all regulations that create a barrier to interagency data sharing. Directs agencies to secure unfettered access to state data from programs that recieve Federal funding, including data collected by third party vendors. Singles out unemployment data for specific attention. Requires review in 45 days of any policy that might result in excessive classification.

records.Title: Eliminating Waste and Saving Taxpayer Dollars by Consolidating Procurement
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets general policy of consolidating procurement functions under GSA. Requires each agency to submit a proposal in 60 days for how to transfer procurement to GSA. Requires GSA to submit holistic proposal to OMB in 90 days. Requires OMB to make an official designation to GSA director to serve as agent for all IT-related procurement. Requires implementation guidance from OMB to agencies in 14 days.

records.Title: Improving Education Outcomes by Empowering Parents, States, and Communities
records.Summary of Oppty: Directs the closure of ED . Directs ED to terminate any DEI or LGBTQ/gender programs.

records.Title: Immediate Measures to Increase American Mineral Production
records.Summary of Oppty: Generally sets policy to increase US mineral production. Requires agencies to submit a list of all pending mineral projects to National Energy Dominance Council in 10 days and for NEDC to prioritize projects within another 10 days. Requires Permitting Council ED to create a plan to expedite priority projects in 15 days. Requires NEDC to issue an RFI to surface regulatory bottlenecks. Requires report to Congress in 30 days on mining waste disposal. Requires DOI to provide a list of all federal lands with minerals on them and to prioritize mining in land use determinations; similar requirement for DOD, USDA, and DOE. Directs similar agencies plus SBA to faciliate funding for these projects in 30 days, including by encouraging private sector investment. Waives Congressional notification requirements. Requires establishment of a mineral production fund for domestic investment. Requires guidance from EXIM bank in 30 days and recommendations from SBA in 45 days on increased public private partnerships.

records.Title: Achieving Efficiency Through State and Local Preparedness
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets general policy of state governments playing a more active role in national security and preparedness. Requires NSA to prepare a National Resilience Strategy in 90 days, a National Critical Infrastructure Policy within 180 days - including national security and supply chain policies, a National Continuity Policy in 180 days, a Preparedness and Response policy in 240 days - including emergency management policies, and a National Risk Register in 240 days. Requires DHS to update the federal national function construct within 1 year.

records.Title: Addressing Risks from Paul Weiss
records.Summary of Oppty: Targets Paul Weiss for having on staff a partner involved in the January 6th prosecutions, hiring the attorney involved in the Manhattan DA's prosecution of Trump, and for having a DEI program. Directs revocation of security clearnances for PW staff, terminating any existing contracts with PW and prohibiting future contracts with PW, and prohibiting hiring of any former PW attorneys without a waiver.

records.Title: Additional Rescissions of Harmful Executive Orders and Actions
records.Summary of Oppty: Rescinds 18 additional EO's, proclamations, etc., related to COVID, foreign policy, LGBTQ rights, minimum wage, enviromental justice, workers rights, tribal sovereignty, and energy.

records.Title: Invocation of the Alien Enemies Act Regarding the Invasion of the United States by Tren de Aragua
records.Summary of Oppty: Designates Tren de Agua as a terrorist organization. Conflates Tren de Agua with Venezuelan government and seems to authorize deportation of all Venezuelans over 14 in the US who have not naturalized or gotten LPR status. Directs AG to prepare a letter in 60 days to this effect to be sent to all courts, states, etc. Bars entry to any US territory to anyone covered under the EO, and permits seizure of any property they hold.

records.Title: Continuing the Reduction of the Federal Beauracracy
records.Summary of Oppty: Virtually eliminates 7 government agencies: Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service, US Agency for Global Media, Woodrow Wilson International Center for Scholars, IMLS, USICH, Community Development Financial Institutions Fund, and MBDA. Directs OMB to reject budget requests for these agencies.

records.Title: Establishing the WH Task Force on the FIFA World Cup 2026
records.Summary of Oppty: Establishes Task Force on the FIFA World Cup 2026 chaired by the President and Vice Chaired by the Vice President. Includes mostly cabinet-level members. Housed in DHS. Requires reports on planning from all agencies by June 1, 2025.

records.Title: Restoring Public Service Loan Forgiveness
records.Summary of Oppty: Generally sets policy that social justice organizations involved in "illegal" activity can't be qualified hosts for PSLF. For the purposes of PSLF, redefines "public service" to exclude organizations it deems to be involved with supporting undocumented people, engaging in violent protest, supporting transgender youth, supporting "illegal discrimination," or engaging in peaceful protest. No reporting or updating requirements.

records.Title: Establishment of the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve and United States Digital Asset Stockpile
records.Summary of Oppty: Generally, establishes the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve and a "Digital Asset Stockpile" for managing USG digital assets. Directs Treasury to create reserve using seized assets and requires all agencies to explore their authorities to transfer Bitcoin and other digital assets to Treasury in 30 days. Directs Treasury and DOC to explore "budget neutral" strategies for acquiring additional Bitcoin. Requires a report from Treasury in 60 days on legal and investment considerations.

records.Title: Amendment to Duties To Address the Flow of Illicit Drugs Across Our Southern Border
records.Summary of Oppty: Apparently reduces Mexico tariffs from 25% to 10% for potash.

records.Title: Amendment to Duties To Address the Flow of Illicit Drugs Across Our Northern Border
records.Summary of Oppty: Apparently reduces Canada tariffs from 25% to 10% for potash.

records.Title: Addressing Risks from Perkins Coie LLP
records.Summary of Oppty: Targets Perkins Coie for their work with Hillary Clinton, George Soros, and for having DEI priorities. Directs DNI to to rescind any PC security clearances and prohibits contracting with PC. Directs EEOC to investigate lawfirm DEI practices in consultation with DOJ. Directs all agencies to provide guidance to staff on barring PC employees from federal buildings, limiting agency staff from interacting with PC, and barring hiring former PC staff.

records.Title: Women's History Month
records.Summary of Oppty: Primarily addresses the Adminsitration's anti-transgender actions. Also touches on increasing access to IVF.

records.Title: Honoring Jocelyn Nungaray
records.Summary of Oppty: Renames the Anahuac National Wildlife Refuge after Jocelyn Nungaray, a 12-year-old who was sexually assaulted and murdered in 2024, allegedly by two undocumented men from Venezuela.

records.Title: Further Amendment to Duties Addressing the Synthetic Opioid Supply Chain in the People's Republic of China
records.Summary of Oppty: Amends China tariffs from 10 to 20%

records.Title: Amendment to Duties To Address the Situation at Our Southern Border
records.Summary of Oppty: Amends de minimis provision of the Mexico tariffs.

records.Title: Amendment to Duties To Address the Situation at Our Northern Border
records.Summary of Oppty: Amends de minimis provision of the Canada tariffs.

records.Title: Designating English as the Official Language of the United States
records.Summary of Oppty: Designates English as official language of the US, but does not require agencies to stop producing materials in other languages.

records.Title: Immediate Expansion of American Timber Production
records.Summary of Oppty: Directs USDA and DOI to issue guidance in 30 days to facilitate increased timber production. Directs DOI to produce a strategy in 60 days on how to improve the speed of forestry project approvals. Requires DOI and USDA to submit a plan in 90 days on annual amount of timber to be offered for sale from federal lands. Requires in 180 days adoption of categorical exclusions from NEPA to speed timber production, and within 280 days new categorical exclusions for timber thinning and salvage. Directs DOI to speed up Endangered Species Act review.

records.Title: Addressing the Threat to National Security From Imports of Timber, Lumber, and Their Derivative Products
records.Summary of Oppty: Requires DOC to investigate the economic impacts of timber and lumber trade practices and produce a report within 270 days that includes recommendations for policy changes (including potential tariffs).

records.Title: Implementing the President's “Department of Government Efficiency” Cost Efficiency Initiative
records.Summary of Oppty: Generally sets a policy of increased transparency in federal funding. Includes several agency requirements: building a tool to record grant and contract payments including a brief justification and posting that system publicly if feasible; reviewing all existing contracts within 30 days to recommend recissions; instituting contract and grant moratoriums; requiring DOGE teams to provide monthly contracting updates to the Administrator; instituting travel and credit card freezes; and submitting a reports in 7, 30, and 60 days to DOGE on real property held by the agency and whether that property should be disposed of.

records.Title: Making America Healthy Again by Empowering Patients With Clear, Accurate, and Actionable Healthcare Pricing Information
records.Summary of Oppty: Generally, restarts healthcare price transparency efforts from first term. Directs Treasury, DOL, and HHS to take action in 90 days to implement and enforce price transparency rules, including by issuing guidance or regulation on standardization and enforcement.

records.Title: Addressing the Threat to National Security From Imports of Copper
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets policy of increasing domestic copper supply. Directs DOC to investigate copper imports, including national security implications, economic impacts, and potential of tarrifs to address any of these implications. Requires a report in 270 days including results of investigation and recommendations for improving the US copper supply chain.

records.Title: Defending American Companies and Innovators From Overseas Extortion and Unfair Fines and Penalties
records.Summary of Oppty: Describes taxes and legal restrictions foreign governments impose on tech companies as unfair. Sets policy to impose reciprocal tarriffs or other restrictions in response to "repair imbalance." Directs USTR to conduct investigations of imbalances where appropriate. Directs Treasury and DOC to identify unfair practices. Directs USTR to secure moratorium on customs duties on electronic transmissions. Directs USTR and DOC to develop a public reporting system for businesses continuing to be subject to duties.

records.Title: Ending Taxpayer Subsidization of Open Borders
records.Summary of Oppty: Reinforces PRWORA prohibition on use of federal funds in ways that benefit undocumented people. Directs every agency to identify all federal programs that permit undocumented people to receive any benefit as well as any federal funding that states could use to support sanctuary cities. Tasks OMB, DOGE, and DPC to produce a report on federal funding for undocumented people and recommendations for enhancing eligibility verification in 30 days.

records.Title: Ensuring Lawful Governance and Implementing the President's “Department of Government Efficiency” Deregulatory Initiative
records.Summary of Oppty: Generally sets policy of the "deconstruction of the overbearing and burdensome administrative state." Requires each agency to work with DOGE to prepare within 60 days a report on unwanted regulations - those that they deem unlawful, burdensome, etc., including an assessment of which are "significant." Instructs OIRA to use this list in consultation with agency heads to develop a Unified Regulatory Agenda. Instructs agencies to deprioritize or cease enforcement of any of these regulations. After this process, directs agencies to work with DOGE on any new regulations. Exempts military, immigration, and national security regulations. Suggests guidance from OMB, but no deadline.

records.Title: Commencing the Reduction of the Federal Bureaucracy
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets general policy of dramatically reducing the size of the Federal government. Eliminates USADF, US Institute for Peace, Presidio Trust, and IAF within 14 days. Eliminates Federal Executive Boards and PMF program. Eliminates several specific FACAs and requires report in 30 days of other FACAs to eliminate across USG.

records.Title: Expanding Access to In Vitro Fertilization
records.Summary of Oppty: Generally sets policy to increase reliable access to IVF. Requires DPC to produce a report within 90 days with recommendations on protecting IVF access and reducing costs for IVF treatment.

records.Title: Ensuring Accountability for All Agencies
records.Summary of Oppty: Generally sets policy that POTUS has control of all federal agencies, including those historically deemed "independent," and requires all agencies to submit regulations to OMB for review. Exempts the Federal Reserve. Requires OMB to produce guidance for agencies within 60 days. Requires heads of independent agencies to regularly consult with OMB, DPC, and NEC on policies and priorities. Requires independent agencies to establish an OWHL and to submit strategic plans to OMB for review.

records.Title: Keeping Education Accessible and Ending COVID-19 Vaccine Mandates in Schools
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets policy that federal funds should be withheld from any school with a vaccine mandate. Requires ED to issue a plan in 90 days to end "coercive COVID19 school mandates" that includes a list of schools that receive funding that have mandates in place and proposals from each agency on how they plan to withhold funds from noncompliant schools.

records.Title: Establishing the National Energy Dominance Council
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets policy to "make America energy dominant" by expanding "all forms of reliable and affordable energy production…" Establishes a National Energy Dominance Council chaired by DOI and DOE to advise POTUS on various energy policy matters, and tasks them with producing a report within 100 days on the energy economy. The report will include proposals for a public education campaign and for energy-related programs and incentives, as well as a market review.

records.Title: Establishing the President's Make America Healthy Again Commission
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets policy of extending American life span. Requires health agencies to focus on reversing chronic disease. Requires agencies to promote affordable healthy food and disease prevention. Establishes a cross-agency Commission that will first work on an assessment report on childhood chronic disease due in 100 days, then on a Make Our Children Health Again Strategy due in 180 days.

records.Title: Reciprocal Trade and Tariffs
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets policy to reduce the annual trade deficit, using the "Fair and Reciprocal Plan," which involves evening all tariff agreements with other countries so the US tariff matches the other country's tariffs - including VAT taxes and anything else that adds to the cost of goods from that country, like wage suppression. Requires a report from DOC and USTR (date unspecified) and a report from OMB on fiscal impacts of tariffs in 180 days.

records.Title: One Voice for America's Foreign Relations
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets policy that for all foreign service officers, "Failure to faithfully implement the President's policy is grounds for professional discipline, including separation." Authorizes Sec. of State to make a preliminary decision on whether to fire any foreign service staff. Directs State to reform workforce to ensure staff "is committed to faithful implementation of the President's foreign policy." Requires revision of the Foreign Service Manual.
