records.Title: Implementing the President's “Department of Government Efficiency” Workforce Optimization Initiative
records.Summary of Oppty: Requires OMB Dir to produce a plan to reduce gov't workforce through efficiency improvements and attrition, including a provision to only hire one person for every four who leave. Requires each agency head to produce a plan for new career appointment hires that will be approved by DOGE team lead. Requires each DOGE team lead to produce a monthly hiring report. Requires every agency to create a RIF plan that prioritizes non-statutory responsibiliites, DEI staff, and "non-essential" workers. Requires OMB regulations in 30 days on suitability criteria, agency reorg plans in 30 days, and a progress report in 240 days. Exceptions for military, national and homeland security, and public safety.

records.Title: Adjusting Imports of Aluminum Into the US
records.Summary of Oppty: Imposes 10% tarriff on aluminum imports. Very long, technical justification provided by DOC.

records.Title: Adjusting Imports of Steel Into the US
records.Summary of Oppty: Imposes 25% tarriff on steel imports. Very long, technical justification provided by DOC.

records.Title: Eliminating the Federal Executive Institute
records.Summary of Oppty: Eliminates Federal Executive Institute, a leadership development for federal employees.

records.Title: Ending Procurement and Forced Use of Paper Straws
records.Summary of Oppty: Declares US policy of ending use of paper straws. Requires agencies to eliminate paper straws. Requires DPC to produce National Strategy to End the Use of Paper Straws in 45 days, including recommendations on how to implement nationwide.

records.Title: Pausing Foreign Corrupt Practices Act Enforcement To Further American Economic and National Security
records.Summary of Oppty: Generally, pauses enforcement of FCPA. Requires AG review of FCPA guidelines and policies in 180 days. During review period, requires review of all active and prior FCPA cases.

records.Title: Gulf of America Day
records.Summary of Oppty: Names Gulf of America Day in honor of Trump's first visit to the Gulf since taking office.

records.Title: Protecting Second Amendment Rights
records.Summary of Oppty: Requires AG review of all regulatory and subregulatory documents for infringement of 2nd Amendment rights within 30 days and submission of a recommended plan of action.

records.Title: Addressing Egregious Actions of the Republic of South Africa
records.Summary of Oppty: Accuses South Africa of civil rights violations against Afrikaners. Prohibits foreign aid to South Africa and requires promotion of resettlement of Afrikaner "refugees" in the US.

records.Title: Establishment of the White House Faith Office
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets policy that faith entities should be on equal footing for federal grants and declares commitment to religious liberty and ending religious discrimination by the government. Renames WHOFBCP to WH Faith Office, headed by an SA that sits in DPC. Requires WHFO consultation with faith orgs on policy issues, convening agency Faith Centers, community skills building on federal grants, and other similar functions. Requires each agency to appoint a Faith Liaison in 90 days.

records.Title: Eradicating Anti-Christian Bias
records.Summary of Oppty: Decries violence against Christians and sets up a DOJ Task Force to Eradicate Anti-Christian Bias. Requires review of all agencies for Anti-Christian policies and a recommendations report to POTUS within 120 days. Also requires a progress report after 1 year and upon dissolution of the TF.

records.Title: Imposing Sanctions on the International Criminal Court
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets policy opposing ICC actions against any nation that hasn't consented to its jurisdiction. Calls ICC prosecutors a threat to national security, bars them from the US, and calls for seizure of any property/assets they have in the US. Also prohibits any support for or from any of those involved in the ICC. Requires Treasury and State to recommend additional people for the list within 60 days.

records.Title: Amendment to Duties Addressing the Synthetic Opioid Supply Chain in the People's Republic of China
records.Summary of Oppty: Amends de minimis provision of the China tariffs.

records.Title: Keeping Men Out of Women's Sports
records.Summary of Oppty: Rescinds funds from all schools that allow trans women to compete on women's sports teams. Directs ED and DOJ to prioritize enforcement of Title IX in cases involving trans women. Requires all agencies to review grants to educational programs to see if they allow trans women to compete with women. Requires DPC to convene athletic organizations, and state AGs to identify best practices on barring trans women from sports. Requires State to withdraw from international programs that permit trans women, to promote international norms and IOC rules on trans women in sports, and to prohibit trans women from entering the US to play sports.

records.Title: Withdrawing the United States From and Ending Funding to Certain United Nations Organizations and Reviewing United States Support to All International Organizations
records.Summary of Oppty: Withdraws US from UNHRC. Orders review of UNESCO membership within 90 days with a focus on any anti-Israeli or anti-Semitic "sentiment." Prohibits any funding for UNRWA and rescinds funding for UNHRC. Requires a report in 180 days of memberships in any international organization and the funding provided for them, all conventions and treaties the US is a party to, and recommendations on which to withdraw from.

records.Title: Progress on the Situation at Our Northern Border
records.Summary of Oppty: Recognizes steps taken by Canada in response to tariffs imposed 2/1, "pauses" tariffs so long as migration and drug crises continue to improve.

records.Title: Progress on the Situation at Our Southern Border
records.Summary of Oppty: Recognizes steps taken by Mexico in response to tariffs imposed 2/1, "pauses" tariffs so long as migration and drug crises continue to improve.

records.Title: A Plan for Establishing a US Sovereign Wealth Fund
records.Summary of Oppty: Requires Treasury and DOC to develop a plan to establish a sovereign wealth fund within 90 days.

records.Title: American Heart Month
records.Summary of Oppty: Annual proclamation on cardiovascular disease.

records.Title: Career and Technical Education Month
records.Summary of Oppty: Reaffirms commitment to vocational education and apprenticeships.

records.Title: Imposing Duties To Address the Synthetic Opioid Supply Chain in the People's Republic of China
records.Summary of Oppty: Imposes 10% tariff on goods from China, ostensibly to reduce the flow of narcotics from China.

records.Title: Imposing Duties To Address the Flow of Illicit Drugs Across Our Northern Border
records.Summary of Oppty: Imposes 10% tariff on goods from Canada, ostensibly to reduce the flow of narcotics and migrants over the border.

records.Title: Imposing Duties To Address the Situation at Our Southern Border
records.Summary of Oppty: Imposes 25% tariff on goods from Mexico, ostensibly to reduce the flow of narcotics and migrants over the border.

records.Title: Limiting Lame-Duck Collective Bargaining Agreements That Improperly Attempt To Constrain the New President
records.Summary of Oppty: Prohibits entering into any CBA in the last 30 days of a presidential administration. Disapproves CBAs entered into in the last 30 days of the Biden Administration, using ED CBA as an example. Creates an exception for police unions.

records.Title: Unleashing Prosperity Through Regulation
records.Summary of Oppty: Generally, sets policy of deregulation. Requires identifying 10 regs for appeal for every one regulation proposed. Requires incremental costs of new regulations to be near zero (after subtracting cost of repealed regulations). Requires a series of guidance documents from OMB but no timeline set and suggests phased implementation. Requires agencies to include every new regulation to be included in the Unified Regulatory Agenda, and states that no new regs should be issued if not included in URA (though OMB Director can make exceptions). Ties incremental cost requirements to budget process. Note that "regulation" is defined broadly in the EO to encompass guidance and other subregulatory documents.

records.Title: National Black History Month
records.Summary of Oppty: Proclaims February National Black History Month. Note that proclamation doesn't capitalize Black and honors some problematic people.

records.Title: National School Choice Week
records.Summary of Oppty: Proclaims this week National School Choice Week and "reaffirm[s] our commitment to empowering American parents with the freedom to choose the education that best suits their values, matches their children's needs, and equips their families to lead long, flourishing, and fulfilling lives."

records.Title: Additional Measures to Combat Anti-Semitism
records.Summary of Oppty: Requires every agency to submit a report in 60 days of authorities that could be used to combat anti-Semitism and an inventory of compaints against colleges/university and K-12 schools alleging civil rights violations as well as a list of related court cases. Separately, requires State, ED, and DHS to make recommendations on how to make higher ed institutions aware of the grounds for inadmissibility in 1182(a)(3) (https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/USCODE-2023-title8/pdf/USCODE-2023-title8-chap12-subchapII-partII-sec1182.pdf).

records.Title: Celebrating America's 250th Birthday
records.Summary of Oppty: Stands up a Task Force 250 to plan 250th anniversary celebration. Reinstates EO's on monuments for first term - including the one that incraeses criminalization of people who vandalize monumnets - and requires DPC to come up with a list of 250 historically significant Americans to include in its garden of heroes. Requires progress report by 3/1.

records.Title: Expanding Educational Freedom and Opportunities for Families
records.Summary of Oppty: Generally, experesses support for school voucher programs. Requires guidance in 60 days on using formula funds for voucher programs. Requires a plan in 90 days on how to expand vouchers. Requires guidance in 90 days on using CCDBG funds for non-govt education including homeschooling. Requires report in 90 days on review of military and Bureau of Indian Education funding streams to see how they can support vouchers.

records.Title: Ending Radical Indoctrination in K-12 Schooling
records.Summary of Oppty: Requires ED, DOD, HHS, and DOJ to prepare a report in 90 days on federal funding that "directly or indirectly" supports any education program related to Black history, LGBTQI+ people, or similar, or that discusses white supremacy, transition, or related concepts. Calls for pulling funding (and even clawing back funding) for schools that support young people who are transitioning. Reestablishes 1776 Commission. Reinforces existing requirements for federally funded schools to have civics programs.

records.Title: The Iron Dome for America
records.Summary of Oppty: Reinstates Star Wars-like missile defense shield project. Requires a report in 60 days from DOD on requirements and implementation plan. Report should include funding plan.

records.Title: Protecting Children from Chemical and Surgical Mutilation
records.Summary of Oppty: Generally, calls for an end to transition-related care for young people. Asserts that WPATH guidance lacks scientific integrity and requires recision of any agency guidance that relies on it. Requires report in 90 days on best practices for promoting health of children with gender dysphoria. Defunds schools and hospitals that perform transition-realted surgeries for young people. Calls for revisions to all trans-inclusive HHS regulations and guidance, including gender affirming care guidance. Requires new regulation banning use of TRICARE for transition support for youth. Calls on DOJ to prioritize enforcement of FGM ban federally and in concert with states, and suggests some convulted legal actions to protect parents' rights to prevent their kids from getting care. Requires a progress report in 60 days.

records.Title: National Day of Remembrance of the 80th Anniversary of the Liberation of Auschwitz, 2025
records.Summary of Oppty: Declares national day of remembrance for the 80th anniversary of the liberation of Auschwitz.

records.Title: Reinstating Service Members Discharged Under the Military's COVID-19 Vaccination Mandate
records.Summary of Oppty: Reinstates all service members that were terminated under the vaccine mandate and provides them with full back pay. Requires a progress report in 60 days.

records.Title: Restoring America's Fighting Force
records.Summary of Oppty: Prohibits DEI programs in the military and requires a review and documentation of all DEI initiatives taken in the past within 90 days. Also requires new DHS and DOD guidance within 30 days and a progress report in 180 days.

records.Title: Prioritizing Military Excellence and Readiness
records.Summary of Oppty: Reinstates prohibition on trans people serving openly in the military and rescinds the Biden era EO permitting open service. Prohibits men and women from sharing sleeping quarters, bathrooms, etc. Requires DOD and DHS to issue new guidance in 30 days.

records.Title: Emergency Measures To Provide Water Resources in California and Improve Disaster Response in Certain Areas
records.Summary of Oppty: Requires DHS, DOD, and DOJ to submit recommendations in 15 days on how to resolve the water shortage for fighting the LA fires. Directs DOI to "deliver more water" and to produce additional hydropower. Requires DOI and DOC to identify regulatory barriers to water projects within 30 days, and requires reporting to DPC and NEC on "California State and local policies or practices inconsistent with sound disaster prevention and response," that the President will use to determine whether grants/contracts/other financial assistance can be withheld. Also requires HUD and FEMA to take certain actions on rebuilding and clearing debris.

records.Title: Council to Address FEMA
records.Summary of Oppty: Suggests FEMA is failing at meeting emergency needs and diverting funds to support undocumented immigrants. Establishes a Council charged with assessing FEMA's capabilities and soliciting input on reform. Council is required to meet within 90 days and submit a report to the President in 180 days.

records.Title: Enforcing the Hyde Amendment
records.Summary of Oppty: Reinstates the Hyde Amendment policy of prohibiting the use of any federal funds to support "elective" abortion. Requires OMB guidance to agencies, but does not set a timeline out for that.

records.Title: Mexico City Policy
records.Summary of Oppty: Reinstates Mexico City policy, which prohibits the use of US foreign assistance funds for reproductive health services.

records.Title: Removing Barriers to American Leadership in Artificial Intelligence
records.Summary of Oppty: Requires production of an AI Action Plan within 180 days, rescinds Biden-era EO's and work product related to AI, and requires revision of M-24-10 and M-24-18.

records.Title: Strengthening American Leadership in Digital Financial Technology
records.Summary of Oppty: Rescinds Biden-era Framework document on digital currency and sets up an infrastructure to produce something similar. Requires agency heads to identify regs and guidance related to digital currency within 30 days and to provide recommendations to the WG chair within 60 days on whether to rescind, revise, or keep those documents in place. Requires a report to the president in 180 days. Generally open-ended, the biggest restriction in the EO is a prohibition on a Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC).

records.Title: Declassification of Records Concerning the Assassinations of President John F. Kennedy, Senator Robert F. Kennedy, and the Reverend Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr.
records.Summary of Oppty: Requires declassification and disclosure of all records related to the assassinations of Kennedy and MLK. Requires planning reports in 15 and 45 days on declassification and release.

records.Title: President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology
records.Summary of Oppty: Revokes Biden-era EO establishing PCAST and establishes its own PCAST with similar areas of focus, such as AI, quantum, and biotech. Names several Administration people as members and says the remaining seats should be filled with external experts. Names Energy as that entity that will fund and provide TA to the new PCAST.

records.Title: Federal Recognition of the Lumbee Tribe of North Carolina
records.Summary of Oppty: Supports full recognition of Lumbee tribe and requires report from DOI in 90 days on what actions are necessary to assist the tribe in gaining full recognition and right to federal benefits.

records.Title: Designation of Ansar Allah as a Foreign Terrorist Organization
records.Summary of Oppty: Designates the Houthis as a terrorist organization.

records.Title: Revocation of Certain Executive Orders
records.Summary of Oppty: Revokes COVID EOs, including vaccination requirement.

records.Title: Ending Illegal Discrimination and Restoring Merit-Based Opportunity
records.Summary of Oppty: Asserts that DEIA programs violate civil rights law. Requires all agencies to "terminate all discriminatory and illegal preferences, mandates, policies, programs, activities, guidance, regulations, enforcement actions, consent orders, and requirements. I further order all agencies to enforce our longstanding civil-rights laws and to combat illegal private-sector DEI preferences, mandates, policies, programs, and activities." Rescinds Biden DEI EOs (including J40 EO) as well as the 1965 EEO EO. Requires OFCCP to stop considering DEI, and requires all agencies to "excise" references to DEI in all acquisitions, contracts, etc. Requires a report in 120 days on actions the administration could take to "encourage" the private sector to end DEI practices, including litigation recommendations and lists of the "most egregious and discriminatory DEI practitioners in each sector of concern." Also requires guidance in 120 days to LEAs and post secondary schools that receive grants from ED on student loans and federal ED funding .

records.Title: Keeping Americans Safe in Aviation
records.Summary of Oppty: Asserts that DEI has made flying unsafe - including because FAA recruited people with disabilities - and requires FAA to end DEI programs.

records.Title: Restoring Names that Honor American Greatness
records.Summary of Oppty: Directs agencies to replace members of US Board on Geographic Names. Renames Denali Mount McKinley. Renames Gulf of Mexico as Gulf of America.

records.Title: Restoring Accountability to Policy-Influencing Positions Within the Federal Workforce
records.Summary of Oppty: Reinstates the 2020 EO on Schedule F, changing the name to "Schedule Policy/Career." Requires Director of OPM to issue guidance in 30 days on categories of positions that agencies should recommend for Schedule Policy/Career. Says that Schedule P/C staff don't have to support the President's policies but "are required to faithfully implement administration policies to the best of their ability, consistent with their constitutional oath and the vesting of executive authority solely in the President. Failure to do so is grounds for dismissal."

records.Title: Application of Protecting Americans From Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act to TikTok
records.Summary of Oppty: Postpones enforcement of TikTok ban for 75 days, during which DOJ will determine what steps to take.

records.Title: Securing Our Borders
records.Summary of Oppty: Generally, calls for use of all available resources to stop the flow of undocumented immigrants. Outlines actions to take including building the wall, sending more personnel to the southern border, and apprehending undocumented people already in the US. Lays out some specifics, including resumption of "migrant protection protocols," ending "CBP One" program, and ending all categorical parole programs. Includes a provision on DNA testing to "determine the validity of claimed familial relationships." Requires a report in 14 days on recommendations for further steps to take.

records.Title: Reevaluating and Realigning US Foreign Aid
records.Summary of Oppty: Asserts that currently foreign aid is misaligned with foreign interests and intimates that exporting American values is destabilizing international relations. Requires 90 day pause on foreign assistance so all grants can be reviewed for continuation, revision, or cancellation. Sec of State can waive pause for any particular program.

records.Title: Protecting the United States From Foreign Terrorists and Other National Security and Public Safety Threats
records.Summary of Oppty: Calls for increased vetting of people seeking admission to the US, as well as people already in the US. Requires a report in 60 days on countries with limited vetting that may be put on full or partial suspension, and on how many people from those countries are in the US and on the activities of those people - and whether they should be deported. Requires a report and recommendations in 30 days on additional actions that should be taken.

records.Title: Defending Women From Gender Ideology Extremism and Restoring Biological Truth to the Federal Government
records.Summary of Oppty: Makes it US policy to recognize only two sexes. Grossly, defines man/woman based on whether they produce eggs or sperm. Requires HHS to issue guidance on gender in 30 days. Requires all agencies to interpret laws in accordance with the EO. Requires changes to passports and other documents. Requires the AG to issue guidance on sex-segregated spaces (reinterpreting Bostock). Prohibits housing trans women in women's prisons, requires HUD to rescind the Equal Access Rule, and requires HUD to issue a rule on single-sex rape shelters. Requires legislative text in 30 days and a progress report from each agency in 120 days. Dissolves Gender Policy Council.

records.Title: Reforming the Federal Hiring Process and Restoring Merit to Government Service
records.Summary of Oppty: Call federal hiring process broken, including use of factors like race and gender identity. Requires federal hiring plan within 120 days that prohibits hiring on the basis of race, sex, or religion.

records.Title: Putting America First in International Environmental Agreements
records.Summary of Oppty: Withdraws US from Paris Agreement and UN Convention on Climate Change, along with any related sub-agreements. Requires report in 30 days through NSC on progress.

records.Title: Clarifying the Military's Role in Protecting the Territorial Integrity of the United States
records.Summary of Oppty: Directs military to prioritize border enforcement and requires report in 10 days of how the US Northern Command intends to do that, followed by a further planning report in 30 days.

records.Title: Restoring the Death Penalty and Protecting Public Safety
records.Summary of Oppty: Reinstates federal capital punishment and requires the AG to pursue the death penalty for murders of police and for any capital crime committed by an undocumented person. Requires state AGs to review the conditions of confinement for the people whose sentences were communted by Biden "to ensure that these offenders are imprisoned in conditions consistent with the monstrosity of their crimes and the threats they pose," and to see if they can be retried on state charges.

records.Title: Realigning the US Refugee Admissions Program
records.Summary of Oppty: Requires USRAP to "admit only those refugees who can fully and appropriately assimilate" and assure that tax dollars are reserved for US citizens. Says states and localities should be granted a role in deciding whether refugees are settled there. Requires suspension of all refugee application decisions - unless they grant an exception. Requires a report in 90 days and every 90 days thereafter on resumption of the refugee program.

records.Title: America First Trade Policy
records.Summary of Oppty: Requires a number of trade policies and reviews of existing policies on things like the trade deficit, tariffs, currency exchange, lost revenue from import of contraband, export controls, etc. and exploring the feasibility of an External Revenue Service (ERS) to collect foreign tariffs and the like. Requires special review of economic relations with China. Requires a series of reports, all due on April 1.

records.Title: Restoring Accountability for Career Senior Executives
records.Summary of Oppty: Requires OPM to issue new SES performance standards in 30 days, authorizes reassignment of any SES staff, termination of Exec Review Boards in favor of all-political ERBs and termination and re-formation of all PRBs.

records.Title: Memorandum To Resolve the Backlog of Security Clearances for Executive Office of the President Personnel
records.Summary of Oppty: Complains about security clearance backlog and calls for list of personnel who should receive interim clearance, then authorizes WH Counsel to supplement the list or revoke clearances as necessary.

records.Title: Promoting Beautiful Federal Civic Architecture
records.Summary of Oppty: Requires every agency to submit a plan in 60 days to advance the policy that federal buildings should be "visually identifiable as civic buildings and respect regional, traditional, and classical architectural heritage."

records.Title: Organization for Economic Co-Operation and Development (OECD) Global Tax Deal (Global Tax Deal)
records.Summary of Oppty: Asserts that OECD "Global Tax Deal" has no force or effect in the US. Requires Treasury and USTR to investigate whether any foreign countries are out of compliace with existing tax treaties or have tax rules in place that disadvantage American companies. Requires report through NEC in 60 days of recommendations for changes to treaties.

records.Title: Putting People Over Fish: Stopping Radical Environ­mentalism To Provide Water to Southern California
records.Summary of Oppty: Calls on NOAA to reroute water from Sacramento area to rest of state, which was challenged under Trump I in part to preserve smelt habitats. Requires a progress report in 90 days.

records.Title: Guaranteeing the States Protection Against Invasion
records.Summary of Oppty: Basically says that the immigration system is intentionally designed to vet people for entry to the US, cites cartels and public health risks as reasons to keep system strict. Declares the "situation at the Southern border" to be an "invasion" and suspends entry until "I determine that the invasion has concluded." Restricts use of asylum. Authorizes any necessary action to deport people already here. No specific reporting requirement.

records.Title: Granting Pardons and Commutation of Sentences for Certain Offenses Relating to the Events at or Near the United States Capitol on January 6, 2021
records.Summary of Oppty: Commutes the sentence of a dozen Jan. 6 folks and directs AG to issue pardons or dismiss charges against everyone else involved.

records.Title: Declaring a National Emergency at the Southern Border of the United States
records.Summary of Oppty: Declares emergency at Southern border and authorizes use of military to "obtain full operational control." Restarts work on the wall. Requires status report from DOD in 30 days and a DOD/DHS report on conditions and recommened actions in 90 days.

records.Title: Unleashing Alaska's Extraordinary Resource Potential
records.Summary of Oppty: Sets US policy to "maximize the development… of the natural resources located on both Federal and State lands within Alaska." Reopens ANWR to drilling and revisits Trans AK Pipeline. Rescinds all regs and guidance addressing AK NPR.

records.Title: Protecting the Meaning and Value of American Citizenship
records.Summary of Oppty: Ends birthright citizenship as of 30 days after issuance. Includes very odd definitions of "mother" and "father." Requires guidance in 30 days from all impacted agencies.

records.Title: Unleashing American Energy
records.Summary of Oppty: Large overlap with "Declaring a National Energy Emergency" EO but broader. Sets policy that USG should explore all kinds of energy - including drilling on the OCS - that no kind of energy (or green tech or green appliances) should be given preferential treatment in USG programs/policies. Requires review of all agency actions that might "burden consumer choice" of energy - including current litigation. and production of report in 30 days. Revokes all Biden energy EOs. Terminates American Climate Corps. Requires guidance in 30 days from CEQ on NEPA permitting, and recommendations on NEPA legislation (no timeline). All Natural Capital work disbanded, including scientific integrity EO. Requires EPA guidance in 60 days on "social cost of carbon." Requires report on greenhouse gas in 30 days. Pauses all BIL/IRA programs, including all EV work. Restarts LNG projects. Requires several actions to support reinvestment in mining non-fuel minerals, including creation of a report within 60 days on recommendations on critical minerals programs and projects.

records.Title: Designating Cartels and Other Organizations as Foreign Terrorist Organizations and Specially Designated Global Terrorists
records.Summary of Oppty: Designates "the Cartels" as terrorist organizations - blames them drugs, criminals, and gangs in the US. Requires naming cartels in 14 days and making preparations for Trump to use Alien Enemies Act against any Cartel people in the US. AEA is supposed to only apply to foreign nations/gov'ts, where US has declared war of POTUS has proclaimed one, allows US to apprehend, restrain, secure, and remove as alien enemies any citizen of that nation.

records.Title: Holding Former Government Officials Accountable for Election Interference and Improper Disclosure of Sensitive Governmental Information
records.Summary of Oppty: Claims 51 signatories to Hunter Biden laptop letter shouldn't have written letter and violated national security principles, weaponizing intelligence for political purposes. Revokes clearance for all 51 plus John Bolton for writing a memoir it says had sensitive info in it. Requires report in 90 days on anyone else invvolved, how to prevent "interference with elections" by intelligence community in furture, and recommendations for disciplinary action.

records.Title: Declaring a National Energy Emergency
records.Summary of Oppty: Basically says that an affordable and reliable source of energy is critical for nation's economic security, along with a reliable energy grid. Requires all agencies to assess their ability to open all federal lands to production of energy and report that to Asst to POTUS for National Security Affairs. Calls for year-round sales of E15 gas, allows for emergency permitting to facilitate energy projects. Requires a report in 30 days recommending other emergency actions and where they need to waive ESA rules, and then a follow-up status report every 30 days thereafter. Basically allows waiver of Endangered Species Act rules where necessary, a speed-up in ESA committee review, and ESA committee recommendations for reducing the ESA committee permitting backlog. Requires assessment in 60 days by NSA of transportation and refining infrastructure in Northeast and West Coast for Army Corps to work on. I believe several renewable resources are defined out of the definition of energy/energy resources.

records.Title: Ending Radical and Wasteful Government DEI Programs and Preferencing
records.Summary of Oppty: Requires termination of all DEI and environmental justice positions, programs, policies, preferences, and activities within 60 days. Each agency must provide OMB with lists of positions and programs, contractors, and grantees that have engaged in DEI/EJ work. Requires DPC to convene monthly meeting with agency heads to discuss appropriate and effective civil rights policies for the Exec Branch, hear about the costs of programs, and "advance the policy of dignity and respect."

records.Title: Establishing and Implementing the President's “Department of Government Efficiency”
records.Summary of Oppty: Establishes DOGE by reorganizing USDS, headed by USDS Administrator, terminating on July 4, 2026. Requires each agency to create 4 person DOGE team within 30 days. Calls for gov't-wide software modernization to ensure interoperability, and grants USDS access to all unclassified agency records.

records.Title: Protecting the American People Against Invasion
records.Summary of Oppty: Immigration EO. Basically calls for full enforcement of all immigration laws. Rescinds Biden immigration Eos. Calls on AG and Sec of DHS to establish Homeland Security Task Forces (HSTFs) in every state, tasked with ending the presence of cartels and gangs, ending drug smuggling and human trafficking - with a focus on kids - and otherwise enforcing immigration law. Directs DHS to assess and collect fines against undocument people "and from those who facilitate such aliens' presence in the United States." Requires a 90 day progress report including recommended action steps. Calls for building new detention facilities so they can house all "removable" immigrants. Deputizes state and local LEOs to act as DHS immigration enforcement officers. Threatens sanctions against countries that won't repatriate people from the US. Reestablishes "VOICE" office, which was tasked with providing services to people who were victims of crimes committed by immigrants. Says sanctuary cities will receive no federal funds. Requires review of funding for NGOs that provides services "directly or indirectly" to immigrants, including a "clawback" provision. Allows DHS to hire a "significant increase in the number" of agents/officers.

records.Title: America First Policy Directive to the Secretary of State
records.Summary of Oppty: States that "the foreign policy of the United States shall champion core American interests and always put America and American citizens first." Requires Sec of State to issue guidance on America First foreign policy.

records.Title: Withdrawing the United States From the World Health Organization
records.Summary of Oppty: Withdraws US from WHO, citing mishandling of COVID 19 and unfair payments. Pauses any payments to WHO and recalls/reassigns any USG staff working with WHO. Rescinds Global Health Security Strategy and calls for a rewrite.

records.Title: Offshore Wind Leasing
records.Summary of Oppty: Prevents consideration of any area in the OCS for any new or renewed wind energy leasing. Does not apply to leasing related to oil, gas, minerals, and environmental conservation. Requires a report to Asst. to POTUS for Econ Policy on authorities to require removal of existing windmills.

records.Title: Flying the Flag of the United States at Full-Staff on Inauguration Day
records.Summary of Oppty: Orders flags at full staff around the world on inauguration day.

records.Title: Initial Rescissions of Harmful Executive Orders and Actions
records.Summary of Oppty: EO that revokes "DEI" Executive Orders and Actions. Revokations include: Racial Justice EOs, Census Apportionment EO, COVID EOs, LGBTQ EOs, Ethics EO, Climate EOs, 2-1 Reg recission EO, Immigration EOs, federal workforce EO (Schedule F), Transgender military service EO, private prisons EO, PCAST EO, Medicaid/ACA EO, OFBNP EO, voting EO, Gender Policy Council EO, AANHPI EO, DEIA EO, Clean Energy EOs, HBCU EO, IIJA EO, Pay Equity EO, Policing EO, Prescription Drug Costs EO, AI EO, and many more. Requires DPC, NEC and NSA to review for any other orders or memos to rescind, due in 45 days.

records.Title: Ending the Weaponization of the Federal Government
records.Summary of Oppty: Accuses Biden Admin of "weaponizing" the USG to "inflict political pain." Uses example of DOJ prosecuting January 6 rioters and dropping cases against people involved with BLM. Requires DNI, AG and agencies to review all exercises of criminal or civil enforcement authority, especially at DOJ, SEC, and FTC. Requires reports but with no timeline.

records.Title: Restoring Freedom of Speech and Ending Federal Censorship
records.Summary of Oppty: EO on "free speech" on the web. Prohibits any federal agency from conducting any mis/disinformation work and requires the AG to investigate mis/dis work agencies have done in the last four years and to provide "recommendations for appropriate remedial actions."

records.Title: Delivering Emergency Price Relief for American Families and Defeating the Cost-of-Living Crisis
records.Summary of Oppty: Lots of language about burden of regulation on american households, including as a result of climate policies. Requires agencies to: "deliver emergency price relief" including by pursuing "actions to: lower the cost of housing and expand housing supply; eliminate... administrative expenses and rent-seeking practices that increase healthcare costs; eliminate... requirements that raise the costs of home appliances; create employment opportunities for American workers, including drawing discouraged workers into the labor force; and eliminate harmful, coercive “climate” policies that increase the costs of food and fuel." Requires a report in 30 days and every 30 days after submitted to the Asst to the President for Economic Policy.

records.Title: Hiring Freeze
records.Summary of Oppty: Puts hiring freeze in place, excepting military. OPM can grant exceptions. Requires plan within 90 days to reduce USG workforce "through efficiency improvements and attrition." Once plan is submitted, freeze expires except for IRS - their hiring freeze remains in place until Treasury and DOGE determine it is "in the national interest."

records.Title: Return to In-Person Work
records.Summary of Oppty: Requires agency heads to "as soon as practicable, take all necessary steps to terminate remote work arrangements and require employees to return to work in-person at their respective duty stations on a full-time basis."

records.Title: Regulatory Freeze Pending Review
records.Summary of Oppty: Freeze on issuing regulations (OMB Director can make exceptions), requires withdrawal of any regs sent to FR that haven't been published. Asks agencies to "consider" postponing effective date of all regs not yet effective (by 60 days). Also authorizes OMB director to establish a review process for all information collections.

records.Title: Helping Left Behind Communities Make a Comeback
records.Summary of Oppty: EO on place-based Economic Development. Create mandates for PBED that I assume will immediately be rescinded by Trump
